notes: Small linked-control safety build. In the RA/COSHH linked-impact screen a Manager can now mark a linked SSW or Toolbox Talk Temporarily unsuitable for use, with a mandatory reason and immutable audit record. While the block is active the current item remains readable for reference/history, but its training cannot be completed, signed, attendance-confirmed, admin-excepted or used as a valid prerequisite; affected assignments and compliance views show red/blocked. Retrain now is also unavailable on blocked material. A Manager can clear the block with a recorded reason, or it clears automatically when a replacement SSW version or replacement TBT is approved. Block and clear history is retained with who/when/why. Supabase migration temporary_suitability_block_v21066 applied. This completes the planned temporarily-unsuitable/block-use piece.
